填入游戏忽略的摇杆中心范围。实体摇杆回中后输出归零。: Enter the central stick range ignored by the game. Output returns to zero when the physical stick is centered.
横轴是手柄转速，纵轴是基础灵敏度的倍率。1× 保持原灵敏度，低于 1× 可以放慢: The horizontal axis is controller rotation speed. The vertical axis is a multiplier of base sensitivity. Use 1× for the original sensitivity or a lower gain for finer adjustments.
先校准游戏满杆角速度，再选择游戏的摇杆响应曲线。校准后保持游戏灵敏度不变。: Calibrate the game's full-stick turn rate, then choose its stick response curve. Keep in-game sensitivity unchanged after calibration.
所选坐标超出了相邻锚点允许的范围。: This coordinate is outside the range allowed by the adjacent anchors.
点图添加锚点，曲线会保持原形。拖动锚点改变响应值，拖动菱形手柄调整弯曲程度。: Click the plot to add an anchor and keep the current shape. Drag an anchor to change the response or a diamond handle to adjust the bend.
将实体摇杆映射到虚拟右摇杆后，有效推杆量 50% 对应满杆转速的 50%。可以单: After mapping a physical stick to the virtual right stick, 50% effective travel requests 50% of the full-stick turn rate. Use this game curve with the stick alone or together with gyro aiming and Flick Stick.
请输入四个逗号分隔的数值，手柄需位于允许的坐标范围内。: Enter four comma-separated numbers with handle coordinates in the allowed range.
贝塞尔曲线至少需要两个锚点，每段需要两个手柄，锚点数不能超过当前曲线的上限。: A Bézier curve needs at least two anchors and two handles per segment, within this curve's anchor limit.
贝塞尔曲线的推杆量或输入值必须随横轴递增。: Stick travel or input on a Bézier curve must increase along the horizontal axis.
游戏转速可以持平或增加。: Game turn speed must stay level or increase.
已达到当前曲线的锚点上限。: This curve has reached its anchor limit.
